puzzles.title: Water Wheel Power
puzzles.description: Calculate the power output of a water wheel based on flow rate and height.
hints: Power is related to the rate of energy transfer.
Gravitational potential energy depends on height.
P = m × g × h / t, where m/t is the flow rate.

puzzles.title: Gear Ratio Calculator
puzzles.description: Given a driving gear with 10 teeth and a driven gear with 30 teeth, calculate the gear ratio.
hints: Gear ratio = Driven teeth / Driving teeth
A ratio of 3:1 means the output spins 3x slower but with 3x torque.
The answer is 3:1 or simply 3.

puzzles.title: Steam Pressure Control
puzzles.description: Design a feedback loop to maintain constant steam pressure in a boiler.
hints: What happens when pressure is too high?
A relief valve releases excess pressure.
Negative feedback maintains stability.

puzzles.title: Binary Message Encoding
hints: 65 in binary: start by finding powers of 2.
64 + 1 = 65, so bits 6 and 0 are set.
The answer is 01000001.

puzzles.title: Logic Gate Circuit
puzzles.description: Create a circuit using AND, OR, NOT gates that outputs 1 only when exactly one of two inputs is 1.
hints: This is called XOR (exclusive OR).
XOR = (A AND NOT B) OR (NOT A AND B)
Think about when each case produces a 1.

puzzles.title: Neural Network Basics
puzzles.description: A neuron has inputs [0.5, 0.3] with weights [0.4, 0.6]. Calculate the weighted sum.
hints: Weighted sum = Σ(input × weight)
The answer is 0.38.

puzzles.title: Optimal Fishing Spot
puzzles.description: Given fish density maps, identify the location with highest expected catch.
hints: Look for areas with highest concentration.
Consider travel time to the spot.
Expected value = probability × payoff.

puzzles.title: Fleet Coordination
puzzles.description: Assign 3 boats to 5 fishing zones to maximize total catch without overlap.
hints: Each boat should have a unique zone.
Prioritize zones with highest yield.
Consider distance between zones.

puzzles.title: Market Price Prediction
puzzles.description: Based on supply trends, predict whether fish prices will rise or fall next week.
hints: High supply = lower prices.
Look at the trend, not just current values.
Consider seasonal patterns.

puzzles.title: Sustainable Harvest
puzzles.description: Calculate the maximum sustainable yield for a fish population with growth rate 0.3 and carrying capacity 10000.
hints: MSY = (r × K) / 4
r = growth rate, K = carrying capacity
The answer is 750 fish per period.

puzzles.title: Fishing Bot Design
puzzles.description: Define the decision rules for an autonomous fishing agent.
hints: What inputs does the agent need?
Define rules: IF condition THEN action.
Consider edge cases and failures.

puzzles.title: Sheep Herding Basics
puzzles.description: Move a sheep from point A to point B using only left/right/forward commands.
hints: Break the path into simple moves.
One command at a time.
Watch the sheep's response before the next command.

puzzles.title: Dog Training Protocol
puzzles.description: Create a 3-command vocabulary for a herding dog.
hints: Commands should be distinct and clear.
Consider: Come, Go, Stop as basics.
Each command needs a unique sound/signal.

puzzles.title: Multi-Dog Coordination
puzzles.description: Assign 2 dogs to herd a flock through a maze with minimal commands.
hints: Position dogs on opposite sides.
Use one dog to block, one to drive.
Minimize total commands for efficiency.

puzzles.title: Breeding Optimization
puzzles.description: Select breeding pairs to maximize a target trait over 3 generations.
hints: Track trait values across generations.
Higher trait parents tend to produce higher trait offspring.
Consider genetic diversity.

puzzles.title: Emergent Flock Behavior
puzzles.description: Define 3 simple rules that cause sheep to naturally flock together.
hints: Boids algorithm: separation, alignment, cohesion.
Each sheep follows these rules locally.
Global flocking emerges from local rules.
